counting_methodology.application_source: Tracked files under frontend/src/ (excluding non-code assets) and backend/app/ (including backend/app/scripts/), excluding tests, alembic migrations, docs, scratch, root scripts, deployment scripts, and node_modules/venv/.next.
counting_methodology.total_lines: Raw newline-delimited lines including blanks and comments.
counting_methodology.code_lines: Non-empty lines excluding single-line comments (# for Python/shell, // for TS/JS/CSS).
